column1: # Where each tool sits in a menu: id, category, subcategory (tab-separated), one
# row per registered tool; `geolibre manifests` emits it as each manifest's
# "taxonomy". Whitebox tools follow the Whitebox Next Gen taxonomy (as in the
# Whitebox-Next-Gen-ArcGIS catalog snapshot, "Category - Subcategory", with a bare
# category as "General"); GeoLibre's own tools are placed in the same vocabulary.
# A new tool needs a row: `every_tool_has_a_taxonomy` fails without one.
